title: Dead man named
article: Vancouver police yesterday released the name of a man who died in police custody May 12.
Ben Robert Matson, 49, of Burnaby, died after being arrested by a "handful" of officers on the Granville Mall.

Det. Scott Driemel said yesterday that preliminary results show that Matson died by choking on his own vomit. Driemel said more than 40 witnesses have been interviewed, and encourages any other witnesses to come forward. All officers involved have also been interviewed for an internal police investigation.
